name: Not To Break You
overview: Scripture reveals that God draws near to those who are brokenhearted and contrite, offering healing and comfort to those who are wounded in spirit (Psalms 34:18; Psalms 147:3). He promises strength, help, and righteous support in times of fear and distress (Isaiah 41:10), assuring His people that His plans for them are for peace and hope, not harm (Jeremiah 29:11). Ultimately, God’s love is demonstrated through the gift of His Son, providing eternal life to all who believe, and affirming that with God on our side, no opposition can prevail against us (John 3:16; Romans 8:31).
